006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.BooleanItemImpl;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * An atomic Metapath item with a boolean value.
017 */
018public interface IBooleanItem extends IAnyAtomicItem {
019  /**
020   * The boolean item value of {@code true}.
021   */
022  @NonNull
023  IBooleanItem TRUE = new BooleanItemImpl(true);
024  /**
025   * The boolean item value of {@code false}.
026   */
027  @NonNull
028  IBooleanItem FALSE = new BooleanItemImpl(false);
029
030  /**
031   * Get the type information for this item.
032   *
033   * @return the type information
034   */
035  @NonNull
036  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IBooleanItem> type() {
037    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.BOOLEAN.getItemType();
038  }
039
040  @Override
041  default IAtomicOrUnionType<IBooleanItem> getType() {
042    return type();
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Construct a new boolean item using the provided string {@code value}.
047   * <p>
048   * The item will be {@link #TRUE} if the value is "1" or "true", or
049   * {@link #FALSE} otherwise
050   *
051   * @param value
052   *          a string representing a boolean value
053   * @return the new item
054   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
055   *           if the provided value is not a valid boolean value
056   */
057  @NonNull
058  static IBooleanItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
059    IBooleanItem retval;
060    if ("1".equals(value)) {
061      retval = TRUE;
062    } else {
063      try {
064        retval = valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.BOOLEAN.parse(value));
065      } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
066        throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
067            null,
068            String.format("Invalid boolean value '%s'. %s",
069                value,
070                ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
071            ex);
072      }
073    }
074    return retval;
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * Construct a new boolean item using the provided {@code value}.
079   *
080   * @param value
081   *          a boolean
082   * @return the new item
083   */
084  @NonNull
085  static IBooleanItem valueOf(boolean value) {
086    return value ? TRUE : FALSE;
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
091   *
092   * @param item
093   *          the item to cast
094   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
095   *         cast to this type
096   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
097   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
098   */
099  @NonNull
100  static IBooleanItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
101    IBooleanItem retval;
102    if (item instanceof INumericItem) {
103      retval = valueOf(((INumericItem) item).toEffectiveBoolean());
104    } else {
105      try {
106        retval = valueOf(INumericItem.cast(item).toEffectiveBoolean());
107      } catch (InvalidValueForCastFunctionException ex) {
108        try {
109          retval = valueOf(item.asString());
110        } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex2) {
111          // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
112          InvalidValueForCastFunctionException thrown = new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex2);
113          thrown.addSuppressed(ex);
114          throw thrown;
115        }
116      }
117    }
118    return retval;
119  }
120
121  @Override
122  default IBooleanItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
123    return cast(item);
124  }
125
126  /**
127   * Get the "wrapped" boolean value.
128   *
129   * @return the underlying boolean value
130   */
131  boolean toBoolean();
132
133  /**
134   * Get the boolean negation of this value.
135   *
136   * @return the negated boolean value
137   */
138  @NonNull
139  default IBooleanItem negate() {
140    return this.toBoolean() ? FALSE : TRUE;
141  }
142
143  /**
144   * Compares this value with the argument.
145   *
146   * @param item
147   *          the item to compare with this value
148   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
149   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
150   */
151  default int compareTo(@NonNull IBooleanItem item) {
152    return Boolean.compare(toBoolean(), item.toBoolean());
153  }
154}
